competitors.name: Private label vs. national CPG brands
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported NielsenIQ and World Data Lab findings that 58% of consumers buy what they need without caring whether the product is national brand or private label. The same report said 68% view private label as a good alternative to national brands and 69% see private label as good value for money.

competitors.name: Kroger / frozen new-product finalists
competitors.action: Supermarket News opened voting for its first Retailer Choice Best New Products Contest and named four frozen finalists: Kroger Private Selection Butter Chicken, Mrs. T's Snack Pierogies, Juicy Lucy and Tem Toa Chicken Pad Thai. The frozen slate is meal-led and global-flavor-heavy rather than pizza-led.

competitors.name: Regional grocers / value execution
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported the 2026 Grocery Value Study from Intouch Insight, Informa Connect and NexChapter. Regional chains scored 84.3% on in-store execution versus 79.6% for national chains, while product availability was the weakest category at 72.2%.

trends.topic: Private-label acceptance broadening beyond value tier
trends.magnitude: 58% of consumers said brand type does not matter if the product meets the need; 67% of Gen Z said private label is just as good as national brands.
trends.context: Premium frozen pizza cannot rely on national-brand familiarity alone. Quality, relevance and value cues need to be obvious enough to compete with retailer-owned alternatives.

trends.topic: Frozen innovation judged through meal solutions and global flavors
trends.magnitude: All four Supermarket News frozen finalists are meal or snack solutions; Kroger's finalist is Private Selection Butter Chicken.
trends.context: Retailer-facing innovation is rewarding differentiated freezer meals and globally familiar comfort formats. Real Dough should keep crust and ingredient quality tied to a clear meal occasion.

trends.topic: Retail value defined by execution, not only price
trends.magnitude: 2026 Grocery Value Study: 82.4% overall in-store execution score; product availability lowest at 72.2%; 43% of consumers go first to a retailer site or app for product details.
trends.context: For premium frozen products, buyer confidence depends on in-stock reliability, clean digital product data and value claims that survive the full shopping path.

market_data.value: $330B in U.S. private-label sales; 24% unit share and 23% dollar share of total CPG market, per Circana data cited by Progressive Grocer

breaking.headline: Consumer Loyalty Shifts Away From National Brands vs. Private Labels: Report
breaking.impact: Private-label parity is becoming a direct shelf-positioning challenge for premium frozen brands.

breaking.headline: Supermarket News names finalists for first-ever Best New Products Contest
breaking.impact: Frozen-category recognition is favoring meal solutions and global comfort formats, including a Kroger private-label finalist.
